fullPassage: Mother cats can tell which kittens belong to them — when litters are mixed up they use their kittens' scent to distinguish them from offspring of other mothers. Despite this, when faced with a selection of kittens who have wandered from the nest, her own and others that aren't hers, a mother cat doesn't appear to favor her own offspring when retrieving them. The reason for this is uncertain, although distress vocalizations from kittens that are lost from their nest are known to be very powerful, so it may just be hard for the mother to resist retrieving them, regardless of whether they are hers. In the wild, a squeaking kitten out in the open is likely to attract predators, which is bad news for any other kittens around it. A rapid rescue of any crying kitten would be a good strategy to prevent them from drawing unwanted attention.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: know → known: be동사(are) 뒤 수동태이므로 과거분사 known
det.analysis: ✅ 정답: known — 'vocalizations ... are __________ to be very powerful'에서 are 뒤는 수동태(be+과거분사)라 known. '알려져 있다'
det.tip: are known to be ~ : be + 과거분사(수동태)

questions.passage: In the wild, a __________ (squeak) kitten out in the open is likely to attract predators, which is bad news for any other kittens around it. A rapid rescue of any crying kitten would be a good strategy to prevent them from drawing unwanted attention.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: squeak → squeaking: 명사 kitten을 앞에서 꾸미는 현재분사 형용사
det.analysis: ✅ 정답: squeaking — 'a __________ kitten'에서 명사 kitten을 꾸미며 '삑삑 소리를 내는'이라는 능동·진행의 의미라 현재분사 squeaking
det.tip: a squeaking kitten : 명사를 꾸미는 현재분사(-ing)

questions.passage: Mother cats can tell which kittens belong to them — when litters are mixed up they use their kittens' scent to distinguish them from offspring of other mothers. Despite this, when faced with a selection of kittens who have wandered from the nest, her own and others that aren't hers, a mother cat doesn't appear to favor her own offspring when retrieving them. The reason for this is uncertain, although distress vocalizations from kittens that are lost from their nest are known to be very powerful, so it may just be hard for the mother to resist retrieving them, regardless of whether they are hers. In the wild, a squeaking kitten out in the open is likely to __________, which is bad news for any other kittens around it. A rapid rescue of any crying kitten would be a good strategy to prevent them from drawing unwanted attention.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸=attract predators: 탁 트인 곳의 울음이 포식자를 끌어들임
det.analysis:
✅ ① attract predators(포식자를 끌어들이다) — 뒤의 '다른 새끼에게 나쁜 소식'과 연결 ←정답
❌ ② find its food(먹이를 찾다) — 위협 맥락과 어긋남
❌ ③ reach the nest(둥지에 도달하다) — 문맥상 무관
❌ ④ calm down soon(곧 진정하다) — 흐름과 반대
det.tip: out in the open is likely to attract predators
